title: Polish 3/7: Doc-comment sweep A — core types, flags, error, config, Ephemeris methods (+ swe_* doc aliases)
description:
### Summary
Documentation-only sweep over the core layer: every public item in src/types.rs, src/flags.rs, src/error.rs, src/config.rs, and every public method on `Ephemeris` in src/context.rs gets a doc comment. Add `#[doc(alias = "swe_...")]` to each Ephemeris method so rustdoc search finds the C names (this replaces a compat module — decided, don't revisit). NO code changes — docs and attributes only.

### Files
- `src/types.rs`, `src/flags.rs`, `src/error.rs`, `src/config.rs`, `src/context.rs`

### Implementation steps
1. **Method docs on Ephemeris** (~50 pub methods, listed by `grep -n "    pub fn " src/context.rs`). Per method: one-sentence summary; the C function it ports as a `#[doc(alias = "swe_calc")]`-style attribute AND named in prose ("Port of `swe_calc_ut`"); parameter units and time scale — this is the highest-value content: JD in TT vs UT1, degrees vs radians, geographic longitude sign convention (east-positive), altitude in meters, pressure in hPa; return-value shape (what's in `CalcResult`, which tret/attr slot maps to which field); error conditions worth calling out (e.g. `CircumpolarBody` from rise/set, TOPOCTR-without-config rejection).
2. Pull unit/scale facts from the existing implementations and golden tests — do NOT guess. Where a method has a documented C-divergence (see docs/codebase-map.md entries and CLAUDE.md <stateless_tolerance>), a one-line "Differences from C" note with a pointer suffices.
3. **types.rs**: doc every enum + variant-group (Body variants need no per-variant prose; model enums get one line each on what the model is + the C constant name). Doc the newtypes (JdTt/JdUt1: which time scale and why they exist).
4. **flags.rs**: per-flag doc lines mapping to C SEFLG_* names and stating interactions already enforced in code (e.g. SPEED3 vs SPEED, HELCTR forcing NOABERR|NOGDEFL via plaus_iflag).
5. **error.rs**: one line per variant, when it's returned.
6. **config.rs**: per-field docs incl. defaults and which C swe_set_* call each field replaces (ephe_path ↔ swe_set_ephe_path, topographic ↔ swe_set_topo, sidereal_* ↔ swe_set_sid_mode, tidal_acceleration ↔ swe_set_tid_acc, astro_models ↔ swe_set_astro_models).
7. Keep comment density consistent with existing good examples in the codebase (e.g. config.rs's module doc). No essays — 2–6 lines per item, units always stated.

### C reference
None to read — C names come from docs/codebase-map.md and the existing code comments. Do not read C source.

### Golden tests
None. `cargo test` must stay green (docs can break doctests if you add fenced code — mark non-compiling fragments as `text` or `no_run`).

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo doc --no-deps` builds clean, no rustdoc warnings
- `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps` passes
- `cargo test` passes
- Spot check: `grep -c "doc(alias" src/context.rs` ≥ 45

### Escape hatch
If a method's units/time-scale can't be determined from the Rust code + golden tests with certainty, STOP for that item and list it in the completion report rather than writing a plausible-but-unverified claim. Wrong unit docs are worse than missing docs.
execution_record: Documented all 5 target files: error.rs (16 variants), flags.rs (7 bitflags structs with per-flag docs mapping to C SEFLG_*/SE_* names), config.rs (TopoPosition + EphemerisConfig fields with C swe_set_* equivalents), types.rs (Body, HouseSystem, CalendarType, SiderealMode, EphemerisSource, all model enums, JdTt/JdUt1, Nutation, Epsilon, DegreeParts, UtcComponents, DeltaT trait), context.rs (Ephemeris struct + 51 #[doc(alias)] attributes on pub methods). 15 pre-existing rustdoc-link warnings (links to private items from orbit.rs/phenomena.rs) unchanged — not introduced by this task. All 177 tests pass.

edges.note: document the settled API surface, not a moving one
missing_docs lint activates only after sweep A covered the core layer
